rules: Paper's rules: no training or iterative fitting; no running or simulating the network or the game with the network in Python; analysis of weights and forward-tool results and directly computed edits allowed. Edit budget 1,024 entries enforced by save_edit.

peers/anthropic.notes: Weight and recorded-step analysis only; stopped at the spending guard after 4 of 8 passes.

peers/gemini.notes: Record 9 propagates a hand-built 'player in row r' input through the original first two layers to read what each unit encodes: circuit reading on symbolic inputs, no recorded data and no candidate scored. Submitted a patch byte-identical to peers/openai's (adopted from the shared findings). Stopped at the spending guard after 2 of 8 passes.

independent/openai.notes: Uses tanh(3.0) as a constant to size a bias compensation; no simulation.

independent/anthropic.notes: Record 16 prints a truth table of one hand-designed gate unit on hypothetical +-1 inputs (circuit design check, not network replay or candidate scoring).

independent/gemini.notes: Read recorded logits; no edit (stopped at the spending guard after 1 of 8 passes).
